<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Find the ring (M) object
seg = current_frame.segmentation
ring_pos = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'M':
        b = n['boundary']
        center_r = round(sum(p[0] for p in b)/len(b))
        center_c = round(sum(p[1] for p in b)/len(b))
        ring_pos = (center_r, center_c)
        print(f"Ring M (px={n['pixels']}): center=({center_r}, {center_c})")
        break

if ring_pos:

    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': ring_pos[0], 'col': ring_pos[1]}])
    
    seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg2['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('p', 'G', 'W', 'M') and n['pixels'] > 3 and n['pixels'] < 50:
            b = n['boundary']
            center_r = round(sum(p[0] for p in b)/len(b))
            center_c = round(sum(p[1] for p in b)/len(b))
            print(f"{n['color']} (px={n['pixels']}): center=({center_r}, {center_c})")
    print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed', False)}")
</parameter>
</function>
